title: Our Own Jev: Typed Decisions in One Forward Pass, from an In-House Judge to Open LoRA Models
title_zh: 我们自己的Jev：一次前向传播中的类型化决策，从内部裁判到开源LoRA模型

paragraphs.en: A typed decision maps evidence, a question and a fixed set of options to a probability for every option, computed in one forward pass, by reading a language model’s logits or a small head over its hidden states, instead of generating and parsing text. The commercial system Jev popularised this System 1 interface, and open reproductions have followed. We report two uses of the pattern. Part I describes an in-house System 1 judge that triages about 148K agentic coding session records for a training corpus. It replaces a frontier LLM judge that cost on the order of $1,000 per pass and whose stored labels matched a fresh two-judge consensus on only 26.9% of the sessions where the two judges agreed; a self-hosted frozen backbone with a rank-16 LoRA adapter and a pointer head answers three typed questions in one forward pass, judges 1,000 sessions in about three minutes of one GPU, about $0.06 at a reference rate and roughly 1% of the frontier judge’s cost, and keeps every session inside the organisation. Part II asks whether a readout that adds no parameters can be competitive and whether training one helps. Applying the public Eikos recipe and corpus of about 25K decisions to three further backbones (1B, 2B and 35B), we read the frozen output layer of a LoRA-adapted decoder. On the 111 public hard items of JevBench our single-seed 35B, developed with those items in view, scores 79.3%, not significantly different from the commercial reference (73.0%, unadjusted p = 0.12 p=0.12 ) and ahead of five open systems after Holm–Bonferroni correction; our 2B is ahead of all four kev checkpoints on the leaderboard. A single-seed ablation finds no detectable benefit from training the 26 letter rows of the output layer, and a retrain on a later corpus release moves the 2B’s hard-tier accuracy by 11.7 points, which shows how little small evaluations resolve.

paragraphs.en: Many operational decisions have a fixed set of allowed answers: which queue a ticket goes to, whether a clause in a document is satisfied, whether a coding session is worth keeping as training data. Today they are usually automated with System 2 machinery: prompt a chat model, ask it for JSON and parse the reply. That spends hundreds of generated tokens on a choice among a handful of options, fails whenever the model writes prose instead of an object, and returns a confidence value the model composes as text rather than computes.
paragraphs.zh: 许多运营决策都有一组固定的允许答案：工单进入哪个队列、文档中的某一条款是否满足要求、一次编码会话是否值得保留为训练数据。 如今这些决策通常用系统2机制来实现自动化：提示一个对话模型，要求它输出JSON并解析回复。 这样做会在少数几个选项之间的选择上耗费数百个生成的token，只要模型写出散文而不是对象就会失败，而且返回的置信度是模型以文本形式拼出来的，而不是计算出来的。

paragraphs.en: A typed decision interface is the System 1 alternative. Given evidence, a question and the options, the model returns a probability for every option from a single forward pass, read from the model’s outputs (its logits, or a small head over its hidden states) rather than generated. The commercial system Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) popularised this interface, and JevBench ( Standhartinger, 2026 ) benchmarks systems that implement it on accuracy, calibration, speed and cost. Because the product is closed, an open-source race followed, with reproductions built on encoders, frozen base models, pointer heads and new readouts (Section 2 ); a fifth project, Eikos ( Vicentino, 2026 ) , releases a corpus, a training recipe, an evaluation harness and models that read letter logits without adding parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 类型化决策接口是系统1（System 1）的替代方案。 在给定证据、问题和选项的情况下，模型通过单次前向传播返回每个选项的概率，该概率直接从模型输出中读取（其logits，或基于其隐藏状态的小型输出头），而非生成得到。 商业系统 Jev（TypeSafe AI, 2026）推广了这种接口，而 JevBench（Standhartinger, 2026）则在准确性、校准、速度和成本方面对实现该接口的系统进行基准测试。 由于该产品是封闭的，随后出现了开源竞赛，人们基于编码器、冻结的基础模型、指针头和新的读取方式构建了复现系统（第2节）；第五个项目 Eikos（Vicentino, 2026）发布了语料库、训练方案、评估工具集以及无需添加参数即可读取字母logits的模型。

paragraphs.en: This paper reports two efforts with the same pattern in two settings.
paragraphs.zh: 本文报告了在两种场景下具有相同模式的两次尝试。

paragraphs.en: Part I: an in-house System 1 judge (§ 2 – 2 ). We collect agentic coding sessions, about 148,000 session records and growing, as training data for an in-house coding model, and each must be triaged by three typed questions before it enters the corpus. A frontier LLM judge cost on the order of $1,000 per pass, needed about 73 hours of judging time, and its stored labels had drifted to the point that, where two fresh judges agreed, their label matched the stored one on only 26.9% of sessions; the data also could not leave the organisation. A self-hosted judge built on the kev architecture (a frozen 4B or 27B backbone, a rank-16 LoRA adapter and a pointer head) answers all three questions in one forward pass, judges 1,000 sessions in about three minutes of one GPU, about $0.06 at a reference rate and roughly a hundredth of the frontier judge’s cost, and reaches 83–85% (coding), 91–92.5% (in-domain) and 68–69.5% (eight-way domain) agreement with frontier-judge labels on a fixed, class-balanced held-out set of 200 sessions (1.5 to 3.8 points lower on the 144 of them that share no state with the training records).
paragraphs.zh: 第一部分：一个自研的系统一评判器（第2–2节）。 我们收集智能体编程会话作为自研编程模型的训练数据，目前已约14.8万条会话记录且仍在增长，每条记录在进入语料库之前都必须通过三个类型化问题的分诊。 一个前沿大模型评判器每轮成本约1000美元，需要约73小时的评判时间，且其存储的标签已漂移到这种程度：当两个新评判器达成一致时，它们的标签与存储标签仅在26.9%的会话上吻合；此外数据也不能离开本组织。 一个基于kev架构（冻结的4B或27B骨干、rank-16 LoRA适配器和指针头）构建的自托管评判器可在一次前向传播中回答全部三个问题，用一块GPU约三分钟即可评判1000个会话，按参考费率约0.06美元，约为前沿评判器成本的百分之一，并且在固定的、类别均衡的200个会话留出集上（其中144个与训练记录不共享任何状态，相应低1.5至3.8个百分点），与前沿评判器标签的一致率达到83–85%（编程）、91–92.5%（域内）和68–69.5%（八分类领域）。

paragraphs.en: Part II: open typed-decision models (§ 5 – 9 ). Part II asks whether a readout that adds no parameters can be competitive, and whether training one helps. We read the existing output layer of a decoder language model at the single position where the answer letter would be generated, restrict it to the letters in play, and train only a LoRA adapter ( Hu et al., 2022 ) with soft cross-entropy. The prompt format (SemIf’s), the training recipe, the evaluation battery and the corpus of about 25K public decisions are those of the open Eikos project, which pairs a letter-logit readout with task training; ours are the adapters for three further backbones (a 1B, a 2B and a 35B mixture of experts), the paired comparisons on JevBench’s 111 public hard items and a single-seed test of whether training the readout helps. The 35B reaches 79.3%: after Holm–Bonferroni correction it is significantly ahead of five open systems, but not significantly different from the commercial reference (73.0%, unadjusted p = 0.12 p=0.12 ). Training the readout buys nothing we can measure, and a retrain of the 2B on a later corpus release moved its hard-tier accuracy from 61.3% to 73.0% although the two runs differ in more than the seed (Sections 8 and 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第二部分：开放的有类型决策模型（§5–9）。 第二部分探讨的问题是：一个不增加任何参数的读出头是否能具有竞争力，以及对它进行训练是否有所帮助。 我们在解码器语言模型中读取答案字母将被生成的那一个位置上的现有输出层，将其限制为参与候选的字母，并仅训练一个 LoRA 适配器（Hu et al., 2022），使用软交叉熵。 提示格式（SemIf 的格式）、训练方案、评测套件以及约 2.5 万条公开决策的语料库均来自开放的 Eikos 项目，该项目将字母 logit 读出头与任务训练配对；我们的贡献是针对三个额外主干模型（一个 1B、一个 2B 和一个 35B 的专家混合模型）的适配器、在 JevBench 的 111 道公开困难题目上的配对比较，以及一次单种子测试，用以检验训练读出头是否有所帮助。 35B 模型达到 79.3%：经 Holm–Bonferroni 校正后，它显著领先于五个开放系统，但与商业参考系统无显著差异（73.0%，未校正 p = 0.12 p=0.12）。 训练读出头没有带来任何可测量的收益，而在较新的语料库版本上对 2B 模型进行重训后，其困难档准确率从 61.3% 提升至 73.0%，尽管两次运行之间的差异不止于随机种子（第 8 和第 9 节）。

sents.en: The 35B reaches 79.3%: after Holm–Bonferroni correction it is significantly ahead of five open systems, but not significantly different from the commercial reference (73.0%, unadjusted p = 0.12 p=0.12 ).

sents.en: Training the readout buys nothing we can measure, and a retrain of the 2B on a later corpus release moved its hard-tier accuracy from 61.3% to 73.0% although the two runs differ in more than the seed (Sections 8 and 9 ).

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarises the open reproductions whose code we read; they differ mainly in where the decision is computed. Laya ( Convai Innovations, 2026 ) is a ModernBERT encoder ( Warner et al., 2024 ) . SemIf ( Lee, 2026 ) reads option-letter logits from an unmodified Qwen3.5-4B, with a structured prompt that Eikos later adopted. kev ( Palmer, 2026 ) adds a pointer head and a block-causal option-isolation mask that lets one pass answer several questions (Part I builds on kev). imajev ( Garg, 2026 ) adds a 256-code readout, copied from the output layer and then trained on about a million decisions. Eikos ( Vicentino, 2026 ) , the source of Part II’s recipe, data and evaluation battery, reads the same letter logits with no added parameters from LoRA-adapted Qwen backbones trained on its own corpus of about 25K decisions. The other systems we compare, from the JevBench leaderboard (“the board”), are reflex ( kshetrajna12, 2026 ) (a Qwen model read by direct logits), Winnow ( Ring, 2026 ) (a LoRA-tuned Gemma), djev ( Maisa, 2026 ) (an inference method on a diffusion language model), jqv ( Octalab, 2026 ) (a zero-shot Qwen3-32B) and OpenJev Verdict ( heman10x, 2026 ) (a 151M encoder). None of Laya, SemIf, kev and imajev combines task training with a readout that adds no parameters; Eikos does (as do other board entries such as reflex-4B), and we build on that idea rather than claim it. Part II supplies evidence on other backbones, paired comparisons with a selection of the field, and a test of whether the readout needs training at all.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 总结了我们阅读过代码的开放式复现工作；它们的主要差异在于决策的计算位置。 Laya（Convai Innovations, 2026）是一个 ModernBERT 编码器（Warner et al., 2024）。 SemIf（Lee, 2026）从一个未修改的 Qwen3.5-4B 读取选项字母的 logits，并使用一个结构化提示词，Eikos 后来也采用了这一做法。kev（Palmer, 2026）增加了一个指针头和一个块因果的选项隔离掩码，使得一次前向传播即可回答多个问题（第一部分建立在 kev 之上）。imajev（Garg, 2026）增加了一个 256 码读出层，从输出层复制而来，随后在约一百万条决策上进行了训练。 Eikos（Vicentino, 2026）是第二部分的方法、数据和评测组合的来源，它从经过 LoRA 适配的 Qwen 骨干模型读取同样的字母 logits，不添加任何参数，该模型在其自有的约 25K 条决策语料上训练。 我们比较的其他系统来自 JevBench 排行榜（“该榜单”），包括 reflex（kshetrajna12, 2026）（一个通过直接 logits 读取的 Qwen 模型）、Winnow（Ring, 2026）（一个 LoRA 微调的 Gemma）、djev（Maisa, 2026）（一种在扩散语言模型上的推理方法）、jqv（Octalab, 2026）（一个零样本的 Qwen3-32B）以及 OpenJev Verdict（heman10x, 2026）（一个 151M 的编码器）。 Laya、SemIf、kev 和 imajev 都没有将任务训练与不添加参数的读出层相结合；而 Eikos 做到了（榜单上的其他系统如 reflex-4B 也是如此），我们是在这一思路的基础上构建，而非声称为其原创。 第二部分提供了关于其他骨干模型的证据、与该领域部分代表性系统的成对比较，以及对该读出层是否需要训练的检验。

paragraphs.en: Scoring multiple-choice answers by the probability of an option symbol is standard in LLM evaluation ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Robinson & Wingate, 2023 ) and can be well calibrated ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) ; models are sensitive to option order and label bias ( Zheng et al., 2024a ; Pezeshkpour & Hruschka, 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2021 ) , which motivates our per-example reshuffling. We measure calibration with expected calibration error ( Naeini et al., 2015 ; Guo et al., 2017 ) , consider temperature scaling and report error under selective prediction ( El-Yaniv & Wiener, 2010 ; Geifman & El-Yaniv, 2017 ) . Soft targets follow knowledge distillation ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) , the rationale loss follows Hsieh et al. (2023) , and we adapt with LoRA through PEFT ( Mangrulkar et al., 2022 ) . Our analysis draws on work on significance testing and power in NLP ( Card et al., 2020 ; Dror et al., 2018 ; Berg-Kirkpatrick et al., 2012 ) , error bars and small test sets ( Miller, 2024 ; Bowyer et al., 2025 ) and seed and numerical variance ( Dodge et al., 2020 ; Bouthillier et al., 2021 ; Madaan et al., 2024 ; Summers & Dinneen, 2021 ; Zhuang et al., 2022 ) , and uses McNemar’s exact test ( McNemar, 1947 ; Dietterich, 1998 ) , the paired bootstrap ( Efron & Tibshirani, 1993 ) and the Holm–Bonferroni correction ( Holm, 1979 ) . Our contamination check is an n n -gram overlap test in the tradition of Brown et al. (2020) , with the caveats of Sainz et al. (2023) . The judge of Part I replaces an LLM-as-a-judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 通过选项符号的概率对多项选择题的答案进行评分是大语言模型评估中的标准做法（Hendrycks et al., 2021；Robinson & Wingate, 2023），且其校准效果良好（Kadavath et al., 2022）；模型对选项顺序和标签偏差较为敏感（Zheng et al., 2024a；Pezeshkpour & Hruschka, 2024；Zhao et al., 2021），这促使我们采用逐样本重排。 我们使用期望校准误差来衡量校准程度（Naeini et al., 2015；Guo et al., 2017），考虑温度缩放方法，并报告选择性预测下的错误率（El-Yaniv & Wiener, 2010；Geifman & El-Yaniv, 2017）。 软目标遵循知识蒸馏（Hinton et al., 2015），理由损失遵循 Hsieh et al. (2023)，并且我们通过 PEFT 使用 LoRA 进行适配（Mangrulkar et al., 2022）。 我们的分析借鉴了关于 NLP 中显著性检验与统计功效（Card et al., 2020；Dror et al., 2018；Berg-Kirkpatrick et al., 2012）、误差棒与小测试集（Miller, 2024；Bowyer et al., 2025）以及随机种子与数值方差（Dodge et al., 2020；Bouthillier et al., 2021；Madaan et al., 2024；Summers & Dinneen, 2021；Zhuang et al., 2022）的研究，并使用 McNemar 精确检验（McNemar, 1947；Dietterich, 1998）、配对自助法（Efron & Tibshirani, 1993）和 Holm–Bonferroni 校正（Holm, 1979）。 我们的数据污染检查是沿袭 Brown et al. 传统的 n 元词组重叠测试。 (2020)，并带有 Sainz et al. (2023) 所指出的注意事项。 第一部分的评判者替代了 LLM 即评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）方法（Zheng et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: The judge of Part I reads its answer through kev’s trained pointer head. Part II asks whether a readout that adds no parameters at all can be competitive, and whether training one helps. The recipe, the corpus and the evaluation battery are those of the open Eikos project ( Vicentino, 2026 ) , whose released models already read letter logits this way; Part II adds adapters for three further backbones, paired comparisons with the commercial system and a selection of the open field on JevBench, and a single-seed test of whether training the readout helps (§ 8 ). It does not compare a pointer head with the letter readout under matched conditions. The two parts share an interface and a lesson, not an experiment: Part I shows what the pattern buys in a deployment, Part II tests the readout on a public benchmark, and in both the evaluation sets (200 sessions, 111 items) are too small to resolve the differences that matter.
paragraphs.zh: 第一部分的评判器通过 kev 的训练指针头读取其答案。 第二部分探讨一个完全不增加参数的读取头能否具有竞争力，以及对其加以训练是否有所帮助。 配方、语料库与评测套件均来自开放的 Eikos 项目（Vicentino, 2026），该项目发布的模型已经以这种方式读取字母 logits；第二部分为三个额外的骨干网络添加了适配器，与商业系统进行了成对比较，在 JevBench 上选取了部分开放领域模型，并对训练读取头是否有所帮助进行了单种子测试（§ 8）。 它并未在匹配条件下将指针头与字母读取头进行比较。 两个部分共享的是一个接口和一条教训，而非同一实验：第一部分展示该模式在部署中能换来什么，第二部分在公开基准上测试读取头，而在两者中，评测集（200 个会话、111 个条目）都太小，无法分辨那些真正重要的差异。

paragraphs.en: The recipe is Eikos’s and we tuned none of it: LoRA adapters of rank 64 on every linear projection, one epoch, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , effective batch 32, soft cross-entropy against a full target distribution over the options, an auxiliary loss on a short written rationale (weight 0.3, never used at inference ( Hsieh et al., 2023 ) ) and option order re-permuted per example. The 1B and 2B follow Eikos’s 4B settings (its first run, without weight averaging or auxiliary terms) and add a symmetric KL divergence (weight 0.5) between the option distributions of an item and of its English or Brazilian-Portuguese view; the 35B follows its 27B settings (no views, a 14,000-token context). Apart from the readout we ablated none of these choices. The data is the public eikos-decisions corpus ( Vicentino, 2026 ) (CC BY 4.0), as cloned on 2026-09-24: programmatically generated items with computed answers, teacher distributions, derivatives of FinEntity ( Tang et al., 2023 ) , TAT-QA and GSM8K training data, long-context dossiers and the views. Our 1B and 2B used a snapshot of 25,130 rows (a task family, a topic and a language held out whole, 1,191 rows) plus 1,619 view rows; our 35B used 24,447 rows. A subset was retracted by the corpus author after our snapshot was taken (Section 9 ). Inference is one forward pass and a softmax over at most 26 logits at temperature 1; several questions about one state share a prefix, as in Eikos’s serving code ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024b ) .

paragraphs.en: We adapt MiniCPM5-1B, MiniCPM5-2B ( Hu et al., 2024 ) and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) with Eikos’s settings by size (Section 5.2 ); each is trained once, with a single seed, and the 2B is released as a merged standalone model ( Kailune-AI, 2026 ) . We score the 231 public JevBench items (commit fd54ea7 , v1.4.2.2; later versions are not rerun) and recompute competitors from its published per-item records, so comparisons are paired (52 systems have such records; we use 15, selected by us; imajev-4b publishes aggregates only). To measure what 111 items cannot, we also use the seven-suite battery of the Eikos repository (7,371 items: the JevBench public items, DecisionBench, Eikos’s template-generated trade and rulebook suites, which make up 31%, a general battery and two finance suites) and its policy of deciding at confidence ≥ 0.9 \geq 0.9 .

paragraphs.en: Paired comparisons use the exact McNemar test, and 95% intervals are exact Clopper–Pearson intervals (mapped to the difference for paired comparisons), except the ECE interval, a 20,000-sample bootstrap. Because we report many paired tests, we apply the Holm–Bonferroni correction ( Holm, 1979 ) within the comparisons we report for each model (11 for the 35B, 15 for the 2B and 3 for the 1B, whose comparison with the commercial reference is descriptive; our selection, not preregistered), call a difference significant only if its adjusted p p is below 0.05, and call the rest not significant, which on 111 items is not evidence of equivalence. A 111-item tier has 80% power only for differences of about ten points between two runs of one recipe (twelve to twenty between unrelated systems, which disagree on more items).

paragraphs.en: Table 3 gives hard-tier accuracy for 15 of the 52 systems whose outcomes the benchmark publishes (our selection; imajev-4b is added from its published aggregates) and the paired differences of our 35B and 2B from each. Of the 37 systems we did not compare, 11 score higher than our 2B (up to 76.6%) and none higher than our 35B. The 35B is significantly ahead of five open systems (Laya, kev 8B, reflex-4B, SemIf and jqv, the last two untrained) and behind the two frontier LLMs by 17.1 points. Against the commercial reference it is + 6.3 +6.3 points (unadjusted p = 0.119 p=0.119 ), so on 111 items we can say neither that it is better nor that the two are equivalent; so does djev, Winnow-12B and reflex-27B. The 35B’s five “ahead” rows do not depend on the choice of Holm family (the largest raw p p is 0.0003). The 2B is significantly ahead of Laya and of all four kev checkpoints, significantly behind reflex-27B and the frontier LLMs, and not significantly different from SemIf, jqv and reflex-4B (60–61% on the hard tier); the 1B is significantly ahead of kev 4B and Laya (a family of three, excluding the reference) and trails the commercial reference by 18.9 points. Three of the 2B’s verdicts sit at the edge: kev 8B, kev 0.6B and reflex-27B would not survive a correction over all 52 systems (adjusted p = 0.148 p=0.148 , 0.154 and 0.182), whereas “ahead of every kev checkpoint”, read as a conjunction, needs only that each raw p p is below 0.05 (the largest is 0.0055). Part II’s first question, whether a readout with no new parameters can be competitive, therefore has only a weak answer: the 35B is significantly ahead of five open systems and not shown to be worse than the commercial reference.

paragraphs.en: For a decision system the operative question is often how wrong it is when it is confident enough to act without review. Table 4 reports, on the 7,371-item battery, the share of decisions made at confidence ≥ 0.9 \geq 0.9 and the error among them: the 35B commits on 42.3% of items and is wrong on 1.9% of those. Two cautions apply. First, up to 31% of the battery is template siblings of the training data, where the models are far more accurate: for the 2B the error among confident decisions is 4.2% on the full battery but 7.7% (95% interval 6.0–9.7) on the four external suites we could score per item. Second, the commercial system’s 5.9% is Eikos’s figure on six suites that exclude the JevBench public items and we did not rerun Jev, so the two are not comparable. On the hard tier our expected calibration error (ECE) is 0.084 (35B), 0.090 (1B) and 0.120 (2B), against imajev-4b’s published 0.082 after its fitted temperature, but ECE on 111 items is noisy (a bootstrap 95% interval for the 2B’s is [ 0.079 , 0.208 ] [0.079,0.208] ). A fitted temperature does not help our larger models: it comes out below one (0.80 for the 35B, 0.95 for the 2B) and worsens hard-tier ECE on held-out halves of the public items. No held-out family, topic or language collapses toward chance at any size (Table 4 , bottom).

paragraphs.en: For MiniCPM5-1B and 2B we trained two arms with identical data, schedule and seed. In trained , the letter rows of W U W_{\!U} are copied into a separate fp32 linear layer and unfrozen; in frozen , the same copied layer stays frozen. paragraphs.en: Table 5 shows no detectable effect. On the hard tier the trained readout is nominally worse at both sizes, but neither difference is significant, and that tier’s minimum detectable effect is about ten points. paragraphs.en: All training data of the Part II models is the public eikos-decisions corpus (CC BY 4.0), apart from 1.7–2.4K public or programmatically generated rows added in two of the further runs of Section 8 ; no proprietary or internal data and no outputs of the commercial system were used. On 2026-09-27 the corpus author removed 1,994 FinEntity-derived rows, because those documents are test items of another benchmark suite (not the DecisionBench of our battery), and asked that they be excluded from future training. Our snapshots were taken on 2026-09-24, so every Part II model, including the released 2B, was trained on them. We report no result on that suite, and an exact match of all 968 documents against five of our evaluation suites found no overlap. We retrained the 2B only without them. The retrain loses 23.0 points on the 300-item financial-sentiment task of the battery’s finance suite (71.7% to 48.7%), a task closely related to what the retracted rows teach, with no significant change on the other two finance tasks (pooled − 2.5 -2.5 points, 95% interval [ − 6.6 , + 1.6 ] [-6.6,+1.6] ), DecisionBench or the general battery, and gains 11.7 points on the JevBench hard tier (Section 8 ). paragraphs.en: We applied the corpus author’s published check (word 8-grams over the state and the question instructions, containment in both directions, flagged above 0.15). Against the 231 public items, no row of the 1B/2B snapshot or of the 35B snapshot is flagged; the maximum containment is 0.0398 and positive controls fire. paragraphs.en: The released 2B was trained on 2026-09-24, before the benchmark was first downloaded to our machines; its development set is a hash split of our own corpus, it was trained once on a fixed schedule with no checkpoint selection, and it ships at temperature 1. The same cannot be said of the 1B or the 35B (both were trained or selected after public-item scores of earlier builds had been seen), of the drill arm of Section 8 (its rows were designed after inspecting public-item failures) or of further builds that we trained and do not report. We report the exact-recipe 35B, chosen when both 35B builds’ public scores were known (79.3 versus 80.2 on hard), launched on 2026-09-27, the day of the retraction, from the snapshot of 2026-09-24. Their public-item numbers are therefore optimistic in the usual way. Nor are the recipe and the corpus independent of the public items: in its own JevBench submission the corpus author states that the 231 public items were one of the project’s development evaluation sets, used to choose its final checkpoint, and that they were never trained on. Our hyperparameters are the upstream ones, so the exposure is indirect. The comparison systems were likewise selected by us from the 52 with published per-item records.

paragraphs.en: The typed-decision pattern holds up in both settings we studied. In-house (Part I), a self-hosted System 1 judge turns a projected $1,000, 73-hour LLM-judge pass over 148K coding session records into about seven GPU-hours, without any session leaving the organisation, at accuracy that 200 held-out sessions cannot distinguish between a 4B and a 27B backbone. In the open (Part II), reading a language model’s own output layer in one forward pass, with a LoRA adapter trained on about 25K public decisions under the Eikos recipe and no new parameters, gives a 35B that is significantly ahead of five open systems (two without task training) on the hard tier and not significantly different from the commercial reference, and a 2B that is ahead of all four kev checkpoints on the board; training 26 letter rows on top of the output layer bought nothing we could measure at one seed. Small evaluation sets bound what either part can claim: a 111-item tier has 80% power only for differences of about ten points between two runs of one recipe and a retrain on a later corpus release (with other changes) moved our 2B by 11.7 points on it.
paragraphs.zh: 类型化决策模式在我们研究的两种场景中都站得住脚。 在内部场景（第一部分），一个自托管的 System 1 评判器把预计需要 1,000 美元、73 小时的 LLM 评判流程（覆盖 148K 条编程会话记录）压缩到约七个 GPU 小时，且任何会话数据都不离开组织，其准确率使得 200 个留出会话无法区分 4B 与 27B 骨干模型。 在开放场景（第二部分），通过单次前向传播读取语言模型自身的输出层，使用按 Eikos 配方在约 25K 条公开决策上训练的 LoRA 适配器且不增加任何新参数，得到的 35B 模型在高难度层级上显著领先五个开放系统（其中两个未做任务训练），且与商业参考系统无显著差异；得到的 2B 模型领先榜单上全部四个 kev 检查点；在输出层之上再训练 26 个字母行，在一个随机种子下没有带来任何可测量的收益。 小型评测集限制了两个部分各自能做出的论断：一个 111 项的层级只有约 10 分的差异才能达到 80% 的统计功效，而在更新的语料库版本上（伴随其他改动）重新训练使我们的 2B 在该层级上移动了 11.7 分。

sents.en: In-house (Part I), a self-hosted System 1 judge turns a projected $1,000, 73-hour LLM-judge pass over 148K coding session records into about seven GPU-hours, without any session leaving the organisation, at accuracy that 200 held-out sessions cannot distinguish between a 4B and a 27B backbone.
sents.zh: 在内部场景（第一部分），一个自托管的 System 1 评判器把预计需要 1,000 美元、73 小时的 LLM 评判流程（覆盖 148K 条编程会话记录）压缩到约七个 GPU 小时，且任何会话数据都不离开组织，其准确率使得 200 个留出会话无法区分 4B 与 27B 骨干模型。

sents.en: In the open (Part II), reading a language model’s own output layer in one forward pass, with a LoRA adapter trained on about 25K public decisions under the Eikos recipe and no new parameters, gives a 35B that is significantly ahead of five open systems (two without task training) on the hard tier and not significantly different from the commercial reference, and a 2B that is ahead of all four kev checkpoints on the board; training 26 letter rows on top of the output layer bought nothing we could measure at one seed.
sents.zh: 在开放场景（第二部分），通过单次前向传播读取语言模型自身的输出层，使用按 Eikos 配方在约 25K 条公开决策上训练的 LoRA 适配器且不增加任何新参数，得到的 35B 模型在高难度层级上显著领先五个开放系统（其中两个未做任务训练），且与商业参考系统无显著差异；得到的 2B 模型领先榜单上全部四个 kev 检查点；在输出层之上再训练 26 个字母行，在一个随机种子下没有带来任何可测量的收益。

sents.en: Small evaluation sets bound what either part can claim: a 111-item tier has 80% power only for differences of about ten points between two runs of one recipe and a retrain on a later corpus release (with other changes) moved our 2B by 11.7 points on it.
sents.zh: 小型评测集限制了两个部分各自能做出的论断：一个 111 项的层级只有约 10 分的差异才能达到 80% 的统计功效，而在更新的语料库版本上（伴随其他改动）重新训练使我们的 2B 在该层级上移动了 11.7 分。

paragraphs.en: Three steps follow. First, a sealed evaluation of our 2B, together with a multi-seed replication of the readout ablation and a retraining of every model without the retracted rows. Second, the 2B rather than the 35B as the candidate deployable open model, once retrained without the retracted rows: its single-question latency on one H100 is about a quarter of the 35B’s (20.5 against 83.2 ms). Third, pointing the open recipe at our own decisions: other bounded, high-volume decisions in the organisation (for example triage, routing and categorisation) share the evidence, question and options shape of Part I, and there we will compare the zero-parameter letter readout against the pointer head directly.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来有三个步骤。 第一步，对我们 2B 模型进行密封评估，同时对读出消融进行多种子复制，并在不含已撤回行的数据上重新训练所有模型。 第二步，选择 2B 而非 35B 作为候选可部署的开源模型，前提是在不含已撤回行的数据上完成重训：其在单张 H100 上的单问题延迟约为 35B 的四分之一（20.5 毫秒对 83.2 毫秒）。 第三步，将开源方案指向我们自身的决策：组织内其他有界、高吞吐量的决策（例如分诊、路由与分类）具有与第一部分相同的证据、问题和选项结构，届时我们将直接把零参数字母读出与指针头进行对比。

paragraphs.en: Typed-decision models are built to automate high-volume decisions, some of which affect people: eligibility, prioritisation and routing of requests. Calibrated probabilities and the low error rate we measure among confident decisions make it tempting to let such systems act without review. Those error rates are measured on benchmark items, not on any deployment distribution, and Section 8 shows how little a small public tier can resolve. Deployments should re-measure calibration on their own traffic, keep humans in the loop for consequential decisions, and treat the confidence threshold as a policy choice. On the positive side, self-hosting keeps sensitive inputs within the organisation that holds them and makes model versions auditable.
paragraphs.zh: 类型化决策模型旨在自动化大批量决策，其中一些决策会影响人：资格判定、请求的优先级排序与路由。 经校准的概率以及我们在高置信度决策中测得的低错误率，让人很容易想让这类系统不经审查直接执行。 这些错误率是在基准测试项目上测得的，而非在任何部署分布上测得，且第 8 节展示了小型公开层所能解决的问题是多么有限。 部署方应在其自身流量上重新测量校准情况，在影响重大的决策中保留人在环路，并将置信度阈值视为一项政策选择。 从积极的一面看，自托管使敏感输入保留在持有它们的组织内部，并使模型版本可审计。
